test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

CEGI : EGIK :: NPRT : ?
solution:
The position of the letters according to the English alphabet series,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The pattern followed here is,

CEGI : EGIK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6646cb484787d40e1c7181ad16137128fb4920aa7b93ad415e8204a795165cf1.png] 

Similarly,

NPRT : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc4299a8ab72e371945744e205dddce9006318838695279cc8483184c188ae87.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"PRTV"**.
